```python
PARAMS = {
    "I0":     (0.3e-6, 0.15e-6, 0.6e-6),   # core branch current (PTAT) at 27C
    "K":      (8.0, 4.0, 16.0),            # beta-multiplier width ratio M4/M3
    "gmid_n": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),          # core NMOS gm/Id (weak/moderate inversion)
    "Ln":     (3.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "gmid_p": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),           # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Lp":     (3.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "kout":   (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),             # output-branch mirror ratio
    "vptat":  (0.40, 0.25, 0.55),          # PTAT drop I3*R2 at 27C (TC trim)
    "vref_t": (0.77, 0.70, 0.85),          # target reference voltage
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I0"]; K = p["K"]; Ln = p["Ln"]; Lp = p["Lp"]; k = p["kout"]
    vdd = 1.8

    # ---------------- beta-multiplier core ----------------
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], Ln, I, vds=0.45)
    W3 = m3.W
    W4 = K * W3

    def vgs_at(W, L, Id, vds, vsb):
        lo, hi = 0.0, 1.8
        for _ in range(50):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lut.op("n", W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] < Id:
                lo = mid
            else:
                hi = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    vgs3 = vgs_at(W3, Ln, I, max(m3.vgs, 0.3), 0.0)
    vr = 0.06
    for _ in range(10):
        vgs4 = vgs_at(W4, Ln, I, 0.5, vr)
        vr = max(vgs3 - vgs4, 0.03)
    R1 = vr / I

    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, I, vds=0.8)
    Wp = m2.W
    W5 = k * Wp
    I3 = k * I

    # ---------------- output branch: x = (I3*R2 + Veb) * R3/(R2+R3) ----------------
    mq = 4
    def veb(ie):
        return 0.76 + UT * math.log(max(ie, 1e-12) / mq / 10e-6)
    vt = p["vref_t"]
    R2 = p["vptat"] / I3
    R3 = 2.0 * R2
    x = vt
    for _ in range(40):
        iq = max((x - veb(max((x - 0.6) / R2, 1e-9))) / R2, 1e-9)
        v3 = veb(iq)
        A = I3 * R2 + v3
        R3 = R2 / max(A / vt - 1.0, 0.05)
        x = A * R3 / (R2 + R3)
    vref_pred = x

    # ---------------- netlist ----------------
    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    n.M("M1", "ng", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M2", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M3", "ng", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W3, Ln)
    n.M("M4", "pg", "ng", "nr", "vss", "nfet", W4, Ln)
    n.R("R1", "nr", "vss", R1)
    n.C("Cpg", "vdd", "pg", 1e-12)
    n.M("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W5, Lp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "qe", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "qe", m=mq)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    # start-up: weak pull-up on st (~0.1-0.3 uA), strong ratioed pull-down
    # by core mirror (8x I), injector pulls pg to ground only while core is off
    n.M("MS1", "s1", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("MS2", "st", "vss", "s1", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("MS5", "st", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 8 * W3, Ln)
    n.M("MS6", "pg", "st", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.5, 1.0)

    # ---------------- predictions ----------------
    i_st = 0.25e-6
    itot = 2 * I + I3 + i_st
    gds_p = max(m2.gds, 1e-12)
    rout = 1.0 / (1.0 / R2 + 1.0 / R3)
    line = rout * k * gds_p * 1.5
    psrr = -db(max(line, 1e-6))
    return n, {
        "vref": vref_pred,
        "tc_ppm": 800.0,
        "line_reg": line,
        "power": vdd * itot,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "startup_ok": 1,
    }
```
